title: MCA's Open House Session on Voluntary Strike-Off: Important Highlights
content:
# MCA's Open House Session on Voluntary Strike-Off: Important Highlights

Ek important update hai. Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) ne Companies aur LLPs ke Voluntary Strike-Off process par ek informative Open House Session organize kiya tha. Yeh session stakeholders ko practical insights dene ke liye conduct kiya gaya.

*   **Session Details:** Yeh Open House Session Thursday, August 20, 2026, ko held kiya gaya tha.
*   **Chaired By:** Session ki chairmanship Additional Secretary Ansuman Pattnaik ne ki thi.
*   **Key Discussions:** Webinar mein companies aur Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) ke voluntary strike-off ke process ko cover kiya gaya.
*   **Form Filings:** Ismein Form STK-2 (companies ke liye) aur LLP Form 24 (LLPs ke liye) filing se related aspects detail mein discuss hue.
*   **Compliance & Rejections:** Reasons for resubmission ya rejection, pre-filing compliances aur document certification jaise critical points par bhi focus kiya gaya, taki stakeholders ko practical compliance analysis mil sake.

*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.mca.gov.in/)
